# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Orchestrates one RED→GREEN→REFACTOR cycle with retries and learning |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | Language-specific pod for Python TDD; delegates code gen and execution |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code for each TDD phase using LLM and playbook context |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Manages playbook CRUD, delta updates, deduplication, persistence |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Logs TDD cycles and ML experiments to PostgreSQL/SQLite |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task outcomes, extracts error patterns and insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes reflector insights into playbook delta bullets |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation |
| AutonomousTDDAgent | src/agents/autonomous_tdd_agent.py | Full autonomous TDD agent with ensemble learning and test review |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines next test increment using LLM and existing context |
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Kent Beck-style RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop with planner |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer with security hash verification |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Container runner backed by rootless Podman |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses Gherkin .feature files into FeatureSpec |
| GoLanguagePod | src/agents/go_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Go TDD cycles |
| TypeScriptLanguagePod | src/agents/typescript_language_pod.py | LanguagePod for TypeScript TDD via vitest in Podman |
| TypeScriptWorkerAgent | src/agents/typescript_worker_agent.py | Generates TypeScript code for each TDD phase |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Drives RED→GREEN→REFACTOR across multiple LanguagePods |
| PodFactory | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Creates LanguagePod instances for a given language |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src/agents/redundancy_checker.py | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy before RED phase |
| TDDFailureRecorder | src/agents/tdd_failure_recorder.py | Records TDD failures and interventions for self-improvement |
| TestReviewAgent | src/agents/test_review_agent.py | Validates test quality before implementation |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Blocks forbidden imports and builtins in generated code |
| ContextMapBuilder | src/utils/context_map.py | Builds AST context map from source files |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval engine for playbook bullets |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval service for code generation |
| EnsembleLearner | src/ensemble/learner.py | Orchestrates multiple models learning in parallel |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates performance metrics from audit trail |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers |
| AuditClient | src/audit/client.py | Write-only audit client for ACE agents |
| AuditStore | src/audit/store.py | Append-only audit store with hash chain integrity |
| PlaybookRepository | src/storage/repository.py | PostgreSQL repository with pgvector for semantic search |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as run_cycle.py
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator

    User->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    activate Runner

    loop max_iterations
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        activate Planner
        Planner-->>Runner: PodSpec
        deactivate Planner

        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle

        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        activate Worker
        Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        activate LLM
        LLM-->>Worker: code
        deactivate LLM
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
        activate Orchestrator
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Orchestrator
        Pod-->>Cycle: red_result
        deactivate Pod

        alt RED aborted (security failure)
            Cycle-->>Runner: failure
        else GREEN retry loop
            loop max_green_attempts
                Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error)
                activate Worker
                Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
                activate LLM
                LLM-->>Worker: code
                deactivate LLM
                Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
                deactivate Worker
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
                activate Orchestrator
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                deactivate Orchestrator
                Pod-->>Cycle: green_result
                deactivate Pod
                alt GREEN passed
                    break
                end
            end
            alt GREEN failed
                Cycle-->>Runner: failure
            else GREEN passed
                Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
                activate Orchestrator
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                deactivate Orchestrator
                Pod-->>Cycle: refactor_result
                deactivate Pod

                opt learning loop
                    Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                    activate Reflector
                    Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                    deactivate Reflector
                    Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                    activate Curator
                    Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
                    deactivate Curator
                    Cycle->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                    activate Playbook
                    Playbook-->>Cycle: added_bullets
                    deactivate Playbook
                end

                Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
                activate Logger
                Logger-->>Cycle: logged
                deactivate Logger

                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult
            end
        end
        deactivate Cycle

        alt planner says COMPLETE
            break
        end
    end

    Runner-->>User: IterativeResult
    deactivate Runner
```
